name: Roasted tomato pasta
description: Sweet roasted tomatoes, garlic and basil folded through warm pasta.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.

steps.instruction: Wash the tomatoes and basil. Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the tomatoes and finely chop the garlic.
Toss tomatoes and garlic with the oil and pepper in a roasting dish. Roast for 20–25 minutes, until softened and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to its packet instructions. Reserve a small cup of cooking water, then drain.
Crush the roasted tomatoes into a sauce. Toss with pasta and basil, adding a splash of the reserved water if needed. Serve hot.

name: Tomato & spinach shakshuka
description: A one-pan tomato and pepper sauce with spinach and gently cooked eggs.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.

steps.instruction: Wash the vegetables. Chop the tomatoes, onion and pepper; mince the garlic.
Heat oil in a wide lidded pan. Soften onion and pepper for 7 minutes, then add garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer, stirring, for 12 minutes until thick. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Make four hollows and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook gently until whites and yolks are firm, about 8–12 minutes. Check eggs are fully cooked before serving.

name: Lemon & red lentil soup
description: A comforting golden soup with carrots, cumin and a bright squeeze of lemon.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.

steps.instruction: Rinse the lentils in a sieve. Wash and dice the carrots; peel and chop onion and garlic.
Warm oil in a saucepan. Cook onion and carrot for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add lentils and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20–25 minutes until the lentils and carrots are soft; add water if too thick.
Let the soup stop bubbling before blending carefully, or leave it chunky. Add lemon juice and serve hot.

name: Chickpea & feta salad
description: Crunchy vegetables, chickpeas and feta with a simple lemon dressing.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.

steps.instruction: Use fully cooked chickpeas or drained canned chickpeas. Rinse and drain them. Wash all fresh vegetables and parsley.
Dice tomatoes and cucumber, thinly slice onion, and chop parsley.
Whisk lemon juice with olive oil. Toss with chickpeas and vegetables, then crumble feta over the bowl.
Serve promptly, or cover and refrigerate until needed. Keep chilled when taking it out for lunch.

name: Berry overnight oats
description: Creamy chilled oats topped with plain yogurt and fresh berries.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.
prepNote: Chill for at least 6 hours or overnight.

steps.instruction: Stir oats, milk and half the yogurt in a clean covered container.
Refrigerate immediately for at least 6 hours or overnight. This waiting time is in addition to the preparation time.
Wash and drain fresh berries. If using frozen berries, follow the packet cooking or thawing instructions first.
Divide the chilled oats between two bowls. Add remaining yogurt and berries; keep any uneaten portion refrigerated.

name: Spinach & potato frittata
description: A golden oven-baked egg dish with tender potato, spinach and feta.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180°C. Wash spinach and potatoes. Dice potatoes into 1 cm pieces; peel and slice onion.
Boil potatoes for 8–10 minutes until tender, then drain. Warm oil in a pan and soften onion; add spinach until wilted.
Whisk eggs and pepper in a bowl, then fold in potatoes, vegetables and crumbled feta. Transfer to an oiled baking dish.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until the middle is firm and reaches 74°C on a food thermometer. Rest briefly before slicing.

name: Hummus & crunchy vegetable wraps
description: Soft flatbread filled with hummus and crisp, colourful vegetables.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.
prepNote: Use soft wholemeal flatbreads or wraps; check hummus labels for allergens.

steps.instruction: Use two soft wholemeal flatbreads or wraps, about 60 g each. Wash and dry the vegetables.
Grate the carrot, slice cucumber into thin sticks and shred lettuce.
Spread hummus over each flatbread, leaving a small border. Add vegetables in a narrow strip through the middle.
Fold in the sides and roll firmly. Cut in half to serve; cover and refrigerate if preparing ahead.

name: Egyptian ful medames
description: Warm cooked fava beans with tomato, cumin, lemon and a little tahini.
adaptationNote: Original Remi adaptation informed by the linked recipe. Ingredients, quantities and method differ; source nutrition values do not apply.
prepNote: Fava beans can trigger favism in people with G6PD deficiency; choose a different recipe if affected.

steps.instruction: Use plain, fully cooked or canned fava beans, not dried beans. Wash tomato and parsley; chop tomato, onion and garlic.
Heat oil in a saucepan. Soften onion for 5 minutes, then add garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add tomato, cooked beans and water. Simmer for 12–15 minutes until hot throughout, stirring and adding water if necessary.
Mash some of the beans with a spoon. Stir in tahini and lemon, and scatter chopped parsley over the top. Serve hot.
